caption: The drawing displays two objects against a plain, off-white background. The first object, positioned toward the upper left, is an irregularly shaped metal plate, dark brown in color with visible rust and aging, featuring four mounting holes and an ornate, jagged perimeter on the left and right edges, as well as a protruding, slightly curved metallic lever with a golden-yellow half-sphere cap at its end. The second object, located towards the bottom center, is a similarly styled metallic lever, separated from the first object, also with a golden-yellow half-sphere cap at one end and a cylindrical fitting at the other. The illustration has a realistic rendering with detailed shading to suggest the three-dimensional form and texture of both metal and golden elements. There is a small inscription at the bottom right that reads "Sam W. Ford Del. 390-1".
title: Lock and Key
